en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a large, neoclassical building with a symmetrical facade, many windows, and a central entrance. In front of the building is a flagpole with a flag at half-mast, set in a landscaped square with benches and people. The image has a serene, historical atmosphere, and there is clear printed Hungarian text at the bottom.
